questions.explanation: The answer is “To avoid repeating an earlier platform mistake.”. Evidence: Last month, I missed a train because I read the wrong platform number. questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Using a past mistake to prepare more carefully”. Evidence: Last month, I missed a train because I read the wrong platform number. Today I try to learn from that experience instead of simply feeling upset. At the station, I check the departure board and find out which platform we need. Then I ask an assistant to confirm the number before we walk upstairs. My cousin is surprised that I spend an extra minute checking. I explain the earlier mistake, and he helps me watch for the correct sign. We reach the platform calmly with enough time to sit together before boarding.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Using a past mistake to prepare more carefully”。原文依据：上个月，我看错站台号，错过了一班火车。 今天，我试着从那次经历中吸取教训，而不只是难过。 在车站，我查看出发信息屏，弄清该去哪个站台。 上楼前，我再请工作人员确认号码。 表亲很意外，我多花了一分钟核对。 我解释了之前的失误，他帮我留意正确标志。 我们平静地到达站台，上车前还有足够时间一起坐一会儿。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Every morning, Suri walks along the same lane to go to school. For a class project, she records the weather along that familiar route. She notes whether the ground is wet and whether shadows fall across the gate. Her teacher asks everyone to hand in a week of observations on Friday. passages.text: Last month, I missed a train because I read the wrong platform number. Today I try to learn from that experience instead of simply feeling upset. At the station, I check the departure board and find out which platform we need. Then I ask an assistant to confirm the number before we walk upstairs. My cousin is surprised that I spend an extra minute checking. I explain the earlier mistake, and he helps me watch for the correct sign. We reach the platform calmly with enough time to sit together before boarding.

parallelText.en: Last month, I missed a train because I read the wrong platform number.
parallelText.zh: 上个月，我看错站台号，错过了一班火车。

parallelText.en: Today I try to learn from that experience instead of simply feeling upset.
parallelText.zh: 今天，我试着从那次经历中吸取教训，而不只是难过。

parallelText.en: At the station, I check the departure board and find out which platform we need.
parallelText.zh: 在车站，我查看出发信息屏，弄清该去哪个站台。

parallelText.en: Then I ask an assistant to confirm the number before we walk upstairs.
parallelText.zh: 上楼前，我再请工作人员确认号码。

parallelText.en: My cousin is surprised that I spend an extra minute checking.
parallelText.zh: 表亲很意外，我多花了一分钟核对。

parallelText.en: I explain the earlier mistake, and he helps me watch for the correct sign.
parallelText.zh: 我解释了之前的失误，他帮我留意正确标志。

parallelText.en: We reach the platform calmly with enough time to sit together before boarding.
parallelText.zh: 我们平静地到达站台，上车前还有足够时间一起坐一会儿。

passages.text: Every morning, Suri walks along the same lane to go to school. For a class project, she records the weather along that familiar route. She notes whether the ground is wet and whether shadows fall across the gate. Her teacher asks everyone to hand in a week of observations on Friday. On Thursday, Suri notices that one page has no date at the top. She checks her small pocket diary and adds the missing information accurately. Her final record shows that even an ordinary daily walk can offer things to notice.
